title: RecurSciBench: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement in Data-Driven Scientific Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.32508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are advancing the automation of data-driven scientific research. Recent advances in recursive self-improvement (RSI) offer the potential for these agents to continuously improve through experience, but evaluating transfer across scientific tasks requires executable, scientifically verifiable tasks and independent assessment of self-improvement gains. We introduce RecurSciBench, a scalable benchmark for evaluating RSI in data-driven scientific research. Its RecurSciPipe framework automatically constructs scientific modeling and data analysis tasks from raw datasets, with execution-based verification and scientific validity checks. RecurSciBench spans four scientific domains, multiple data modalities, and varied scientific objectives. translated_title: RecurSciBench：数据驱动科学研究中递归自我改进能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体正在推动数据驱动科学研究的自动化。递归自我改进（RSI）的最新进展为这些智能体通过经验实现持续改进提供了潜力，但评估改进能力在科学任务间的迁移，需要可执行的、科学上可验证的任务以及对自我改进收益的独立评估。我们提出了RecurSciBench，一个用于评估数据驱动科学研究中递归自我改进的可扩展基准。其RecurSciPipe框架能够从原始数据集中自动构建科学建模和数据分析任务，并提供基于执行的验证和科学有效性检查。RecurSciBench涵盖四个科学领域、多种数据模态和多样化的科学目标。我们通过比较四个RSI系统在源任务上演进前后于独立任务上的表现来评估它们，覆盖了同类型内、跨类型以及跨领域的迁移。
tldr: 该论文提出了RecurSciBench——一个用于评估大语言模型智能体在数据驱动科学研究中递归自我改进能力的可扩展基准，其RecurSciPipe框架可从原始数据集自动构建带科学验证的任务，并在四个科学领域上系统评估了四个RSI系统的自我改进迁移效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RecurSciBench, a scalable benchmark for evaluating recursive self-improvement of LLM agents in data-driven scientific research, whose RecurSciPipe framework automatically constructs scientifically verifiable tasks from raw datasets and systematically assesses transfer of self-improvement gains across four scientific domains.
